task: Re-review of repaired XrayGame (xray_shoot) after run-2026-09-01T21-57-11-s9cr repair (iter-2 review lost to reviewer timeout)

notes: artifact is the repaired XrayGame.tsx + BodyInsideView.tsx (hazeSide); verify battery PASS

actions: Iteration-2 repair: (1) removed all answer-repeating guidance — shoot screen no longer restates the order sheet's timing rule; breath labels are now neutral observations; the only place the timing rule and target part exist is the order sheet (C). (2) Body-part choice now has real consequences: any part can be shot; delivering a wrong-part image is rejected by the doctor and counts as a wasted exposure (X-ray burden — a real professional constraint stated in the order). No more blocked-until-correct gate. (3) Lung reading de-guided: tapping a lung only focuses it; the haze must be spotted visually; findings submission judged with misread counter. (4) Hold window tightened 1400->1000ms. (5) E screen now reports wasted shots + retakes + misreads. verify battery PASS.

Iteration-3 repair addressing brute-force + consequence blockers: (1) X-ray exposure budget — every shutter press consumes 1 of 5 exposures (stated in the order sheet as patient burden); exceeding the budget FAILS the case. (2) Wrong finding submitted twice FAILS the case (delayed diagnosis). (3) A failed case restarts with a NEW random case, so brute-forced answers do not carry over. (4) Case now has 3 variants: haze right / haze left / clean lungs — 'どちらもきれい' is a real correct answer, killing pattern-matching. (5) Findings unlock only after observing both lungs. (6) Part choice labels no longer contain 肺 (order says 肺, player maps to むね). (7) E screen reports exposures/misreads/attempts; perfect play distinguished. verify battery PASS.
